مُنِيرٌ act. part. n. of 4: see 1. ―
-b2- [Hence the saying,] لَسْتَ فِى هذَا الأَمْرِ بِمُنِيرٍ وَلَا مُلْحِمٍ (tropical:) [Thou art not in this affair a commencer nor a finisher: or a person who will do harm nor one who will profit]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
